title: Return an average
prompt: The average of two whole numbers, decimals kept, from an `average` helper that `mean_of` uses: mean_of(1, 2) is 1.5.
starter:
func mean_of(a, b) -> float:
	return (a + b) / 2
hints: average adds the two and divides by a float, since dividing two ints drops the decimals; mean_of returns average(a, b).

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
